snippet.title: Let's Build a Dungeon - Official Overview Trailer | Indie Fan Fest 2026
snippet.description: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create. Let's Build a Dungeon will be available on Xbox and Steam in 2026.
